_comment: Evolution Engine / Warframe offset dump v2

anchor_walks.description: Disabled historical misinterpretation retained as a guardrail.
anchor_walks.name: from_mainInterface_WRONG_DO_NOT_USE

anchor_walks.description: Generic LEA RDX, [RIP+disp32] used by Evolution Engine to load global pointers before an indirect call. Ambiguous until narrowed in IDA.
anchor_walks.name: lea_rdx_global_candidate
anchor_walks.note: 48 of 52 candidates land in .pdata (unwind/debug metadata, not game state); 4 are in data sections

live_verification.hint: 4 of 52 candidates point at plausible user-mode memory — inspect these in IDA
live_verification.name: lea_rdx_global_candidate

patterns.name: mainInterface
patterns.notes: Single unique hit, but this is an anti-debugger routine: cmp [rip+disp]; je +2; int 0x2c/0x2d. The forum's world-singleton interpretation was wrong. Keep for anti-debug RE only; never emit as a player/world pointer.

patterns.name: is_avatar_friendly_prologue
patterns.notes: Prologue of IsAvatarFriendly. Walk into the function to find the vtable call and confirm semantics in IDA.

patterns.name: is_avatar_friendly_vtable_call
patterns.notes: Candidate vtable-call pattern. It may disappear or become multi-hit after an engine update.
patterns.source: forum Engine.cpp Structs.h IsAvatarFriendly epilogue comment

patterns.name: lea_to_global_singleton
patterns.notes: Generic LEA-to-global plus indirect-read shape. The v2 dumper will report every hit and will not silently use the first candidate.

patterns.name: mov_rcx_rip_global
patterns.notes: MOV RCX, [RIP+disp32] then CALL. Useful as a lazy-singleton/init candidate, not a semantic guarantee.

patterns.name: xmm_movaps_subps_movaps
patterns.notes: Generic SSE block. Use only as an IDA hint; multi-hit results are expected.

stable_contracts.description: Warframe.x64.exe is ASLR-backed. Static PE ImageBase is not the runtime address; resolve the loaded module base first, then add the RVA.
stable_contracts.name: runtime_module_base_plus_rva

stable_contracts.description: Every C++ object with virtual methods has its vtable pointer at offset 0. This layout is more stable than a build-specific RVA.
stable_contracts.name: vtable_at_object_plus_0
stable_contracts.use: Read 8 bytes at object_address + 0, then inspect the vtable only after confirming the object type.

stable_contracts.description: Entity containers may contain pointer indirection. Confirm each dereference in the current build before treating it as an entity pointer.
stable_contracts.name: container_to_entity_indirection
stable_contracts.use: Read and validate every pointer before following it; do not assume a forum chain is still current.

stable_contracts.description: A unique byte-pattern hit proves bytes, not meaning. Confirm the function, callers, object layout, and live values in IDA/runtime before shipping an offset.
stable_contracts.name: pattern_hit_is_not_semantics
stable_contracts.use: Mark patterns as candidates until semantic and live verification agree.
